title.zh: 【香港金管局推出代理式金融 SAGE 项目，Circle、碇点金融等入选专家小组】
title.en: 【香港金管局推出代理式金融 SAGE 项目，Circle、碇点金融等入选专家小组】

current_state.zh: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched the SAGE project and a 22-member agentic finance expert group to explore AI-agent payments, KYA identity verification, interoperability standards, and legal and consumer-protection frameworks.
current_state.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched the SAGE project and a 22-member agentic finance expert group to explore AI-agent payments, KYA identity verification, interoperability standards, and legal and consumer-protection frameworks.
